headline: Sensex and Nifty tumble as banking stocks drag market; TCS and Aeroflex Industries see significant gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Geopolitical tensions and rising global yields are weighing heavily on investor sentiment
Significant selloff in the banking sector with Nifty PSU Bank down 1%
Profit booking in stocks like Cupid after reaching recent 52-week highs
Global trade risks and weak cues from Chinese markets clouding the outlook
whatHappening: Sensex tumbled over 900 points from its intraday high, with Nifty 50 slipping below 22,400
TCS shares rallied 6% over two sessions following the announcement of its Q2 results
Bonfiglioli Transmissions announced a Rs 2,534-crore IPO with a price band of Rs 558-586
Aeroflex Industries shares surged 13% ahead of a key board meeting regarding expansion plans
summary: Indian markets witnessed a sharp selloff on October 12, with the Sensex dropping over 500 points and Nifty falling below the 22,400 mark. While banking stocks struggled, IT major TCS and mid-cap firms like Aeroflex Industries and Suzlon bucked the trend with notable gains. Global geopolitical tensions and trade risks continue to pressure domestic indices.
